chunks: He is the Knower of the Unseen, so He does not disclose to anyone His unseen (secret).

key_terms.الْغَيْبِ: The Unseen / The Hidden (that which is beyond human perception)
key_terms.عَالِمُ: The Knower (one who possesses complete knowledge)

ai.seo_question: Who does Allah reveal His secrets to regarding the Unseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the exclusivity of divine knowledge, distinguishing between Allah's absolute, independent knowledge of the Unseen and the contingent, granted knowledge of the Prophets and Imams. It underscores that revelation is not an inherent right of the messenger but a bestowal by Allah's will, reinforcing the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt as the primary recipients and interpreters of this divine secret.
